title: UNICORE 8.0 University Corridors for Refugees — University of Turin Scholarship (a.y. 2026-2027 / 2027-2028)
official_source: Università degli Studi di Torino (within the UNHCR-promoted UNICORE 8.0 project)
program_type: Refugee-student scholarship within the UNHCR-coordinated UNICORE 8.0 University Corridors project: a two-year Master's scholarship for refugee students resident in listed countries of Africa and Asia, run by the University of Turin
description: UNICORE 8.0 (University Corridors for Refugees) is a project promoted by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees that creates educational corridors from selected countries in Africa and Asia to Italy, in partnership with MAECI, Caritas Italiana, Diaconia Valdese and a group of Italian universities. For the 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 academic years the University of Turin awards three two-year cash-and-services scholarships for refugee students to access its open-access, English-taught Master's degree programmes. title: MOFA Taiwan Scholarship (Taiwan Scholarship Program)
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, plus pre-degree Mandarin Language Enrichment Program (LEP)
official_source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of China (Taiwan)
program_type: Government scholarship (Taiwan Scholarship Program of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
duration: Pre-degree LEP: one year. Degree programmes: undergraduate maximum four years, master's maximum two years, doctoral maximum four years. Award periods must be continuous with no breaks and cannot exceed five years in total.
description: The Taiwan Scholarship Program of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of China (Taiwan), funds international students for degree programmes or a pre-degree Mandarin Language Enrichment Program at Mandarin-teaching institutions affiliated with MOE-accredited universities. Recipients receive a monthly stipend of NT$33,000 for degree programmes or NT$28,000 for the LEP, plus one-way economy-class air tickets for direct flights to and from Taiwan, and must cover all other expenses themselves. title: Huayu Enrichment Scholarship (HES), Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
official_source: Ministry of Education (MOE), Republic of China (Taiwan)
program_type: Government non-degree language scholarship (Ministry of Education Huayu Enrichment Scholarship, awarded through ROC overseas missions on merit)
duration: A 2-month summer course, or a 3-month, 6-month, 9-month or one-year course.
description: The Ministry of Education of the Republic of China (Taiwan) established the Huayu Enrichment Scholarship to encourage international students to study Mandarin Chinese in Taiwan. The award funds a 2-month summer course or a 3-month, 6-month, 9-month or one-year course, and pays a monthly stipend of NT$28,000. Applicants must be foreign nationals aged 18 or over with an excellent academic record and good moral character, must already have applied to a Chinese language centre, and must submit their documents to the ROC overseas office for their country of nationality. title: Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP) - Ph.D. Scholarship and Stipend, Academia Sinica
official_source: Academia Sinica (Taiwan International Graduate Program), in collaboration with partner universities
program_type: Research-based doctoral scholarship programme administered by a research institute (Academia Sinica) with partner universities
duration: PhD programme of three years. The stipend is paid for the first year and, for students who perform well, extended for one more year; after the scholarship/stipend allowance period, further financial support depends on the individual thesis advisor.
description: The Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP), administered by Academia Sinica with partner universities, admits international students to fourteen English-taught Ph.D. programmes and pays a tax-free stipend of NT$40,000 per month for the first year, extendable for one further year for students who perform well. title: International Industrial Talents Education Special Program (INTENSE Program)
official_source: Ministry of Education (MOE), Republic of China (Taiwan), with the National Development Council, participating universities and partner companies
program_type: Industry-academia collaboration degree programme (MOE specialised class) with a compulsory employment obligation in Taiwan after graduation
duration: Typically a two-year degree programme of study plus internship, followed by employment in Taiwan.
description: The International Industrial Talents Education Special Program (INTENSE Program) is a Ministry of Education initiative, run with the National Development Council, participating universities and partner companies to recruit international students into industry-linked degree programmes in key fields such as STEM, finance and semiconductors. title: NTU International Outstanding Graduate Student Scholarship
official_source: National Taiwan University (NTU), Office of International Affairs
program_type: University merit scholarship with a matching-fund structure (university tuition waiver plus a thesis supervisor's research-assistant salary)
duration: Minimum monthly support for two years for master's students and three years for PhD students, subject to passing an annual review.
description: The NTU International Outstanding Graduate Student Scholarship supports current international graduate students at National Taiwan University through a matching-fund structure: NTU waives the student's tuition, while the student's thesis or dissertation supervisor pays a monthly research-assistant salary, with published minimums of TWD 6,000 per month for two years for master's students and TWD 8,000 per month for three years for PhD students, before tax. title: NTHU International Student Scholarship
official_source: National Tsing Hua University (NTHU), Office of Global Affairs
program_type: University scholarship for international degree students combining a full tuition and credit-fee waiver with a tiered monthly stipend
duration: Follows the duration of the degree programme enrolled in; no separate award period is published.
description: The NTHU International Student Scholarship, funded by the Office of Global Affairs at National Tsing Hua University, is applied for through the same online system as admission to an NTHU international degree programme. It provides a full tuition and credit-fee waiver plus a tiered monthly stipend: NTD 20,000 to 40,000 per month for doctoral students, NTD 10,000 per month for doctoral students in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences or the International Intercollegiate PhD Program with supervisors from that college, and NTD 5,000 per month for master and bachelor students.
